name: lying-single-arm-trap-raise
instructions:
1. Setup in a prone position on one side of a table with your arm hanging freely and your chin supported on the end of the table.
2. Raise your freely hanging arm overhead by allowing the shoulder blade to upwardly rotate on the ribcage.
3. Finish at a 135 degree angle of shoulder flexion.
4. Slowly lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
